CreateEventWizardValidationPlan owns current form-key selection and schedule validation policy. composition.currentLayout: One three-stage form serves new events, repeated templates, restored drafts, and imported events: Event basics; When & where; then Guests/Booking & live guide. Optional details are disclosed on demand. Review is explicit before creation. createRouteStatus resolves route club loading/error/not-found/ready branches before CreateRouteScreen renders CreateEventScreen. CreateEventWizardStep owns canonical step order, titles, form-key spec construction, and schedule-validation metadata. CreateEventWizardValidationPlan owns current form-key selection and schedule validation policy. CreateEventWizardState owns step header/footer/mutation/success display state plus typed back/primary/save-draft intents. CreateEventSuccessNavigationEffect owns success destination, manage-event route parameters, and route extra payload. CreateEventDraftSnapshot owns draft dirty-tracking signature and EventDraft serialization. CreateEventDraftActionState owns new-vs-existing draft dirty decisions, draft id selection, and save/update success copy. CreateEventDraftRestoreState owns EventDraft-to-form restore mapping, stale enum fallback, restored schedule text, location restore state, policy restore state, and restored Event Success defaults. CreateEventDraftSideEffectState owns draft-check, picker visibility, picker delete intent, and post-submit delete intent policy. CreateEventScreen keeps form-controller assignment, PageController movement, platform picker execution, controller mutation triggers, and Navigator/context side effects inline.
